title: Kenyan Luxury Seafood Breakfast
localName: Kifungua Kinywa cha Samaki cha Kifahari
community: Coastal Kenya — the luxury hotel beachside breakfast
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Luxury Seafood Breakfast — butter garlic prawns, smoked fish, soft scrambled eggs with coriander, avocado slices, and a glass of freshly squeezed mango juice. The ultimate Mombasa beachside hotel breakfast — the Indian Ocean's gifts for the morning.
longDesc: The luxury seafood breakfast at a Kenyan coastal hotel is one of the world's great breakfast experiences — fresh prawns sautéed at sunrise, smoked fish from the morning's catch, perfectly scrambled eggs with fresh coriander, and the warm Indian Ocean visible from the breakfast terrace.
ingredients: Lemon wedges and pili pili sauce
steps: Make garlic butter: melt butter with garlic. Cook 1 minute.
Add prawns. Cook 2—3 minutes until pink. Add coriander and lemon. Remove.

Soft scramble eggs: melt butter in non-stick pan. Add beaten eggs, cream, salt, and pepper. Stir constantly over low heat until just set but still glossy. Remove from heat — the residual heat finishes them.
Arrange everything on a warm plate.
Serve with mango juice and toasted sourdough.
chefTips: Soft scrambled eggs are removed from heat slightly before they look done — residual heat finishes them.
Prawns take 3 minutes — watch them like a hawk.
Warm plates are essential for this breakfast.
commonMistakes: Overcooked scrambled eggs — dry and rubbery.
cookingScience: Soft scrambled eggs require the pan to be removed from heat before the eggs are fully set. The residual thermal energy in the pan and eggs continues to cook them for 20—30 seconds after removal. Stopping on the stove when "just right" produces overcooked eggs; stopping 20 seconds before produces perfect eggs.
sustainabilityTips: Morning-fresh prawns from local Mombasa fishermen — the most sustainable and most flavourful choice.
healthBenefits: Exceptionally high protein from multiple seafood sources.
Omega-3 from prawns and smoked fish.
Complete B-vitamin profile from eggs and seafood.
culturalNote: The luxury seafood breakfast at a Kenyan coastal hotel is one of the most extraordinary morning dining experiences in Africa — the fresh Indian Ocean seafood, the tropical fruit juice, and the morning sea breeze create a sensory experience that stays with guests for years.
